periods.summary: Carl Arlanz is the United States' hidden architect behind the crisis. At the ruined Rebellion headquarters he and Abraham seize Tsukikage, Kazamatsuri, Rinna and Sara, then in the Tatra base he explains that the United States wants to frame the League as the sole manipulator of Rebellion so that American 'justice' can justify war. His personal motive is even more grotesque: unrestricted human experimentation and, ultimately, the creation of the strongest life-form. He reveals PSYON to be mass-produced Abraham Carter clones made with the Tyrant's DNA. While decoys keep Nango, Edelweiss and Fu Xiaoli busy, the real Arlanz steals Blutsauger, the Tyrant's Device, travels to Japan, uses an Abraham clone to immobilize miniature Ikki, and abducts Stella as the intended mother for his ultimate being.

key_events.summary: Appears behind Abraham's accusations and confirms the Union's war pretext.
Brainwashes, tortures and blackmails Tsukikage and Kazamatsuri while explaining the American plan.
Reveals PSYON as an army of Abraham Carter clones after Ouma defeats one.
Uses a Magic Creature decoy and a collapse trap while the real Arlanz escapes with Blutsauger.
Ambushes Ikki and Stella at Hagun and carries Stella away.
